title: Intangible
description: Reduce all damage taken and HP loss to 1 this turn.
smart_description: Reduce all damage taken and HP loss to 1. Lasts for the stack amount in turn(s).
notes: This power acts as a damage cap, limiting all damage taken to exactly 1 per hit. It also reduces HP loss to 1. Decrements by 1 at the end of each enemy turn.
